devices.name: 边界路由器
devices.config_script:
interface GigabitEthernet0/0/0
 ip address 192.168.1.1 255.255.255.252
 undo shutdown
#
interface GigabitEthernet0/0/1
 ip address 10.0.0.1 255.255.255.0
 undo shutdown
